speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: If you are sitting, sit. The beans will not string themselves.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Thirty shillings. That's over the quarter's.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Thirty. I will count them as I would count them from anyone.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Tied in the apron. They are not in the quarter's cloth.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: And what's in the box in London, that you lock twice?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Twenty pound and eight. To the shilling.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: And what a share may bring between Bartholomew and Christmas, if the Mayor lets us alone. I have no weekly rate. The house is dark, and a rate would be a guess.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A house. Here. I've said so.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: You've said so since Susanna was in a biggin. Don't promise me a house, Will. Buy one and I'll believe in it.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: No. But you could tell me which, and then I'd know you'd looked.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Six beans. The rest can wait. You have said the part that was new.
